name: Godavari Rainforests
description: The dense, ancient tropical wetlands surrounding the mouth of the Godavari River in southern Jambhudweepa.
notes: A pristine rainforest domain filled with spice-root, wild yam-beasts, and crocodile spirits. It was the ancestral seat of the Vanaric clans and the birthplace of the sacred Bhuta-Kāna tree.
sources: The Mythic Legacy and Ritual Order of Jambenson
